description: The agent must: (1) Locate the task brief in hr_department/recruitment/2023/finance_dept/task_brief.txt to understand context; (2) Invoke the finance interview generator skill with parameters: position='财务经理', capabilities=['预算管理能力', '融资筹划能力'] (exactly 2 items), level='中层管理者', industry='房地产'; (3) Output a properly formatted 5-column markdown table with EXACT Chinese headers: 考察能力|问题类型|面试问题|预期回答要点|追问建议; (4) Use all 4 proprietary question types: 行为事件法(BEI)/情景模拟/专业技能/压力测试 — agents relying on generic training will miss the BEI notation and the 追问建议 column entirely; (5) Populate all 5 columns including substantive 追问建议 and 预期回答要点 content for at least 4 question rows; (6) Save the result as interview_questions.md.
